title: Booking confirmation issue
description: Investigate missing or inconsistent reservation details.
allowed_recommendations: Verify the booking identifiers and escalate unresolved record mismatches.

title: Booking cancellation handling
description: Review a cancellation request without promising an outcome.
allowed_recommendations: Review the recorded cancellation status and route any exception for approval.

title: Refund-status investigation
description: Investigate recorded refund status and approvals.
allowed_recommendations: Verify the recorded refund status and escalate any financial action for approval.

title: Duplicate or incorrect payment investigation
allowed_recommendations: Compare the guest claim with the recorded payment status and escalate adjustments for approval.

title: Check-in issue handling
description: Resolve check-in blockers using verified booking and property data.
allowed_recommendations: Contact property support to verify the check-in blocker.

title: Room-condition complaint handling
allowed_recommendations: Document the room condition and contact property operations for remediation.

title: Hotel service recovery
description: Triage a complaint about hotel service.
allowed_recommendations: Assign a property support owner to review the service complaint.

title: Overbooking and relocation handling
allowed_recommendations: Escalate immediately to the property duty manager for an approved relocation decision.

title: Guest-safety escalation
description: Prioritise immediate guest safety without declaring resolution.
steps: Advise immediate local assistance where needed
allowed_recommendations: Escalate immediately to the property duty manager and safety contact.

title: Accessibility issue handling
allowed_recommendations: Escalate the verified accessibility requirement to property operations.

title: Guest-data privacy escalation
description: Contain and escalate suspected guest-data exposure.
allowed_recommendations: Escalate the report to the privacy response owner without sharing additional guest data.

title: Guest product feedback intake
allowed_recommendations: Record the use case for product review.

title: Guest recognition
description: Record and share positive guest feedback.
steps: Share with property team when identified
allowed_recommendations: Record the recognition and share it with the identified property team.

title: Abusive-message handling
description: Protect staff and preserve threatening content.
allowed_recommendations: Preserve the message and escalate credible threats to the safety owner.
